responsibility: Implements GCC’s main RTL combiner pass, which uses LOG_LINKS and local dataflow to substitute the results of earlier single-set instructions into later insns and thereby fuse linked pairs, triplets, and selected quadruplets into target-recognizable patterns. Beyond the core try_combine machinery, this file maintains register/value tracking, updates notes and links after successful substitutions, creates extra pseudo copies to avoid over-constraining register allocation, and handles follow-up CFG and jump-label rebuilding when combining changes control-flow form.
